thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Elevated 5xx rates detected from inference services in eu-west-1a. Impact: ~12% of requests returning 5xx over the last 3m. Auto-alert created.

emily (oncall): I'm paged, on it. Can someone drop recent error samples?

jon (sre): grabbing logs now, looks like a mix of ENI detach and connect timeout from the node pool. Short excerpts:
```
2026-03-15T12:02:14Z inference-gw eu-west-1a 10.0.5.23 connect error: dial tcp i/o timeout
2026-03-15T12:03:01Z host-1 kernel: ENI eth0 reset, link down
2026-03-15T12:03:02Z host-1 kernel: ENI eth0 attached
```

emily (oncall): OK ENI flapping. Is it everywhere in eu-west-1a or just specific instance types?

reza (infra): Initial EC2 metadata shows increased network interface reset counters on g5/gn5 instances in that AZ. Running quick describe:
```bash
aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces --filters 
  Name=availability-zone,Values=eu-west-1a 
  Name=status,Values=available,associated 
  --query 'NetworkInterfaces[*].{Id:NetworkInterfaceId,Status:Status,AttachTime:Attachment.AttachTime}'
```
Results show several quick attach/detach events in the past 5m.

aws-status-bot: AWS eu-west-1a reported an internal networking event (investigating). See https://status.aws.amazon.com/ for updates.

harpreet (pm): Customer-impact note: traffic to hosted-inference is showing increased latency and ~12% error spike. Should prepare comms if we can't mitigate in 30m.

emily (oncall): Triage options: 1) route traffic away from eu-west-1a to eu-west-1b/c (preferred), 2) spin up additional dedicated capacity in other AZs and shift model routing, 3) enable immediate fallback to lighter model variant in eu-west-1a to reduce pressure. Thoughts?

jon (sre): I'm starting cross-AZ routing. Pushing a routing policy change to the smart-router to de-prioritize eu-west-1a for new requests. Existing prefetched KV caches will remain but we can stop new session creations there. Command: 
```json
{"action":"update_route_policy","region":"eu-west-1","deprioritize_az":"eu-west-1a","reason":"ENI_flap_in_1a"}
```

emily (oncall): Deploy-bot, do we have a safe config to redirect session creation?

deploy-bot: Rolling a canary change to router config (5% -> 50%) for session-routing away from eu-west-1a. Watch jaeger/slo panels for errors.

maria (support): I see a small set of customers (IDs C-21, C-87) reporting timeouts. Triage email drafted but holding until we know scope.

jon (sre): Also enabling cross-AZ KV hot-warm strategy so requests hitting eu-west-1a can fetch cached prefixes from eu-west-1b. This reduces redundant token generation.

emily (oncall): Good. Reza, can you request instance replacement / stop-start for the flapping hosts as a short-term mitigation?

reza (infra): Yes. I'm cordoning node group eu1a-infer-g5 and draining pods. Then will stop/start instances flagged with repeated ENI resets. Commands: 
```bash
kubectl cordon node/host-1
kubectl drain node/host-1 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
aws ec2 stop-instances --instance-ids i-0abc1234 && aws ec2 start-instances --instance-ids i-0abc1234
```

emily (oncall): Noted. Will monitor error % after routing change. If errors persist we will failover fully to eu-west-1b/c.

aws-status-bot: AWS update: Engineers are investigating network interface instability affecting a subset of EC2 instances in eu-west-1a. No ETA yet.

jon (sre): After route change at +6m error rate dropped from 12% -> 4% for new sessions. Latency still elevated for in-flight sessions.

emily (oncall): Starting customer-impact classification:
- Severity: Partial degradation (P2) — some requests time out but overall platform functional
- Affected surface: Hosted inference in eu-west-1a, Dedicated customers in that AZ may see retries
- Mitigation status: routing change in progress, host restarts in progress, AWS investigating

harpreet (pm): I'll draft a short status update for customers and keep it to factual items only.

maria (support): Sending targeted pings to the two complaining customers with a note we are mitigating and will follow up.

emily (oncall): Handoff plan: I'm keeping the incident until stabilization or 13:00 UTC. If unresolved by then I'll hand to oncall-secondary. Who is the secondary?

jon (sre): Reza will take over if emily needs to hand off. Reza, you good?

reza (infra): I can take handoff. I'll keep AWS contact open and collect instance-level metrics for postmortem.

deploy-bot: Router canary moved to 80% away from eu-west-1a. No anomalous errors triggered by config.

emily (oncall): Good. One more quick check: any burst of NAT gateway errors / SNAT exhaustion?

jon (sre): NAT metrics look normal. This looks specific to ENI resets on certain host types (likely hypervisor/host-side network).

aws-status-bot: New AWS post: "We're seeing degraded network connectivity for a subset of instances in eu-west-1a. We're isolating the underlying infrastructure and will update."

emily (oncall): Will escalate to P1 if errors jump above 20% or customer impact widens. For now maintain P2 and continue mitigation.

harpreet (pm): Action items assigned in incident doc:
- emily (oncall): monitor and coordinate handoff (owner)
- reza (infra): collect instance attach/detach events, AWS communication (owner)
- jon (sre): measure routing impact and KV warm redirects (owner)
- maria (support): customer comms and tracking (owner)

emily (oncall): I'm starting a short bridge/zoom for updates (link posted in incident doc). If anyone needs to join DM me.

maria (support): Customers acknowledged the note, asking for ETA. Told them we're working with AWS and routing mitigations are active.

jon (sre): At +30m error rate for new sessions ~1.2%, overall system trending back to normal as AWS isolates problem.

emily (oncall): I'm handing off to reza for overnight watch; reza will coordinate final instance restarts and confirm AWS root cause. Keeping incident open for postmortem.

reza (infra): Ack. I'll collect the logs, instance lifecycles, ENI attach/detach times and open a follow-up ticket with AWS support.

incident-bot: Incident updated: status=stabilized, severity=P2, handlers=[emily (oncall), reza (infra)], start_ts=1825000000, update_ts=1825000900

emily (oncall): Thanks team. Postmortem owners: reza (infra) and jon (sre). I'll draft the timeline and initial blameless notes.

harpreet (pm): Great — keep me posted on the RCA and comms.

maria (support): Will follow up with the impacted customers once we have more detail from AWS.

reza (infra): Quick note for postmortem: capture kernel/ENA driver versions, instance lifecycle events, and router fallback behavior.

jon (sre): Adding: evaluate improving auto-fallback thresholds so we reduce customer impact faster next time (e.g., auto-deprioritize AZ if 5xx > 5% for 2m).

emily (oncall): End of thread for now — handoff complete.
